about: The shape of a network's file, with made-up addresses. It deploys nowhere: it has no admin and its chain id is 0. Copy it to <chain id>.json and fill it in. adminIsDeployer (optional, false when left out) keeps the deployer as admin and beacon owner, for a test network with one key; admin is then ignored. maxAge and assetCooldown are seconds; sessionOpen and sessionClose are seconds after midnight UTC; closedDays are days since 1970, UTC; pull is 1 for a router that takes its input with transferFrom and 2 for one that takes it through Permit2; source is 0 for no price and 1 for a Chainlink feed; session is 0 for always open and 1 for US stock hours. priceDevBps is how far a price may be from its average for the keeper to trade at it. flags is 1 to switch the keeper on for an asset, which needs a feed, an averageFeed (the same source's one-hour average) and a range: minPrice and maxPrice in the feed's units, the ceiling above the floor and at most twice it; 0 and 0 is no range.
